validation: Source-grounded synthetic fixtures, exact local PDF metadata inspection; no live provider parse.

sources.basis: Selected pages are inserted into a NEW PDF before downstream parsing; non-prefix local indices cannot be treated as original-PDF positions.
Pipeline enumerates pages of the resulting input PDF, including empty-page placeholders.
VLM output page_idx is assigned from the resulting input-page enumeration.
Flat content_list page_idx uses zero-based indexing.

hosted_documentation.hash_basis: Exact HTTP response body bytes, not rendered text; body was inspected but not retained in these synthetic fixtures.
hosted_documentation.basis: Hosted page_ranges and per-file page_ranges are string selectors using 1-based inclusive positions. Hosted offset, ordering and overlap conventions are not guaranteed.

local_policy: Only V4 exact original-PDF byte bindings can opt in through retained top-level page_ranges or pages options and canonical requested coverage.
The pages option is an internal adapter alias, not a claimed hosted API parameter.

A single selector 1 or 1-N, normalized only for surrounding/interior ASCII JSON whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF), must exactly agree with one requested range starting at 1 and ending inside the independently inspected source.
Original-PDF and selected-prefix local zero-based indices coincide; neither suffix offsets nor comma-list reorder/overlap semantics are inferred.
Unknown, nested, alternate and falsy page selectors, physical slices, V1 contexts and indices beyond the prefix fail closed.
Observed block positions never establish complete, completed or missing page coverage. Full-document v1 fixture bytes and historical import profiles remain frozen.
